ITURP5252024.title: Calculation of free-space attenuation
ITURP5252024.supports: Free-space received power between ideal isotropic antennas; amplitude scales inversely with distance under fixed wavelength and matched antenna conditions.
ITURP5252024.scope: Supports amplitude law only. It is not cited as validation of the project's baseband phase or finite-window approximation.

GolubPereyra1973.verified: Publisher abstract confirms elimination of linear coefficients through the pseudoinverse and constant-rank conditions for derivatives. Bibliographic metadata is retained in citation_metadata.json.
